newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ March dwelling permits fell in line with trend.
newsitem.headline: NZ March dwelling permits fell in line with trend.

text.p: Provisional data for dwelling building approvals in March showed a continued gradual month on month fall as an estimated 1,806 new dwelling units were authorised, Statistics New Zealand said on Friday.

"This is 17.4 percent fewer than in March 1996," SNZ said, adding that the trend estimate decreased by 1.6 percent from February to March 1997 after increasing slightly during the period October 1996 to January this year.
The data showed that the short-term trend estimate has stabilised over the last six months, deputy government statistician Ian Ewing said.
"This period of relative stability follows three years of large variation in dwelling consent statistics," he added.
